unit_title: Molecular and Ionic Compound Structure and Properties

guided_journeys.story_title: The Solid That Changed Its Rules
guided_journeys.tagline: Separate extended ionic lattices from discrete molecular particles, then move to electron representations.

guide.name: Dr. Mina Cho
guide.visual: white lab coat, black clipboard, and a transparent particle-model tray
guide.story_job: Mina makes the particle arrangement visible before naming the structural model.

guided_journeys.premise: Two solids look similar from across the room but respond differently when their particles and electrons are examined.
guided_journeys.mission: Distinguish ionic and molecular solids, then use a Lewis representation and formal-charge bookkeeping at the drafting desk.
guided_journeys.finale: The gallery labels the two structural models correctly and opens the electron drafting archive.
